entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Present: Mr.Panku Chaudhary, Advocate, for the appellant.
Mr Janesh Mahajan, Advocate, Special Public Prosecutor, for the respondent-CBI.
Mr Janesh Mahajan, learned Special of Public Prosecutor, appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the respondent-CBI.

rt Records be called for.
Cr. MP No. 691 of 2026 Notice in the aforesaid terms.
Reply, if any, be filed within a period of four weeks.

The applicant/appellant was convicted and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for three years, pay a fine of 25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) and in default of payment of fine to undergo further rigorous imprisonment for four months for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 120-B read with Section 420, 467, 468 and 471, of IPC and Section 13(1)(d) read with Section 13(2) of PC Act; to undergo rigorous imprisonment for three years, pay a fine of 10,000/-(Rupees Ten Thousand) and in default of payment of fine to undergo further simple imprisonment for three months for the commission of offence punishable under Section 467 of IPC;
and to undergo rigorous imprisonment for three years, pay a fine of 10,000/-
.
(Rupees Ten Thousand) and in default of payment of fine to undergo further simple imprisonment for three months for the commission of offence punishable under Section 468 of IPC, in Corruption Trial No. 24-S/7 of 2020 of (Registration No. 22 of 2020), dated 5.12.2025/15.1.2026.

Keeping in view the fact that the appeal is not rt likely to be heard at the earliest as many appeals are pending disposal before this Court, the operation and execution of the substantive sentence of imprisonment imposed by learned Trial Court is ordered to be suspended till further orders, subject to deposit of fine, if not deposited earlier, and furnishing personal bond in the sum of 25,000/-
with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of learned trial Court within a month from today with an undertaking to appear before this Court as and when called upon to do so and surrender before the learned Trial Court to serve sentence, in case of dismissal of the present appeal.
A copy of this order be sent to the learned Trial Court for information and necessary action.

The applicant/appellant is permitted to produce a copy of this order, downloaded from the Webpage of the High Court of Himachal Pradesh, before the authorities concerned, and the said authority shall not insist on the production of a certified copy, but if required, may verify the passing of the Babli Sharma vs .
